description: This file contains utility functions for converting and processing tools related to Google Generative AI and LangChain, including handling function declarations, tool configurations, and conversions between different tool types.

methods.name: convertToolsToGenAI
methods.description: Converts a list of GoogleGenerativeAIToolType objects into GenerativeAITool objects and creates a tool configuration based on extra options.

methods.name: processTools
methods.description: Processes a list of tools, converting them to GenerativeAITool objects and aggregating function declarations.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolToGenAI
methods.description: Converts an OpenAI tool definition into a FunctionDeclarationsTool with appropriate function declarations.

methods.name: createToolConfig
methods.description: Creates a tool configuration object based on provided tools and extra options such as tool choice and allowed function names.
